title: Nfestive Malty Shattering Yam Pilaf
description: A festive malaysian dish featuring gluten-free yams baked in a tava-griddle with coriander leaves for a savory and aromatic meal.
instructions: Preheat your tava-griddle to medium-high heat.
Trim and peel the yams, then dice them into bite-sized pieces.
Mix the salt and ginger powder with the diced yams in a mixing bowl.
Sprinkle the coriander leaves over the yam mixture.
Transfer the yam mixture evenly onto the heated tava-griddle.
Cook for 10 minutes on each side or until golden brown and tender.
Serve hot as an accompaniment to your main meal.
